      Standard error computed as SD / √n per decade from weight_lbs in the club's catch-record CSV. One record flagged anomalous_weight_value (6 lb, well under the club's 30 lb qualifying minimum) was excluded as a likely data-entry error. Rows with missing weight, year, or decade were also excluded. The 2020s figure covers only 2020–2025 and is not a full decade.

      Mean fish per year (decade chart) = total qualifying catches in the decade ÷ number of years with logged catches in that decade (both the 1920s and 2020s are partial decades in the record, 6 years each).

      Total weight is the straight sum of weight_lbs across all qualifying catches in the period — it reflects both how many fish were logged and how big they were, so it falls faster than mean weight alone as catch volume has declined.

      Combined report assembled from three source analyses of the Tyee Club of British Columbia catch registry (tyee_club_catch_records_master.csv), 1924–2025.
